hooks.name: Suggest commit message after changes
hooks.description: After agent execution completes, prompts Kiro to suggest a conventional commit message and PowerShell git command for the modified files.

action.prompt: If any files were modified during this session, generate a conventional commit message (type(scope): description) and provide the full PowerShell git command (git add + git commit) ready to copy-paste. Use the workspace root as the working directory. Do not execute the command — only display it in the chat.
